description: This PHP script handles the display and processing of a survey within the SuiteCRM application. It validates request parameters, fetches survey data, manages campaign tracking, and dynamically generates an HTML page with survey questions, including different input types like text, checkbox, radio, dropdown, date/time pickers, and rating widgets.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering survey-related templates, especially for the closed survey page.

methods.name: displaySurvey
methods.description: Renders the survey form with all its questions, including a submit button.

methods.name: displayQuestion
methods.description: Generates the HTML markup for a single survey question based on its type.

methods.name: displayTextField
methods.description: Outputs a text input textarea for a survey question of type Text.

methods.name: displayRadioField
methods.description: Outputs a set of radio buttons for a survey question of type Radio.

methods.name: displayRadioButton
methods.description: Outputs a single radio button with label.

methods.name: displayMultiselectField
methods.description: Outputs checkboxes for a question allowing multiple selections.

methods.name: displayScaleField
methods.description: Outputs a set of radio buttons representing a scale from 1 to 10.

methods.name: displayRatingField
methods.description: Outputs a dropdown for star rating selection, enhanced with JavaScript.

methods.name: displayMatrixField
methods.description: Outputs a matrix table allowing responses across multiple options and scaled options.

methods.name: displayDateTimeField
methods.description: Outputs a datetime picker input field.

methods.name: displayDateField
methods.description: Outputs a date picker input field.

methods.name: displayClosedPage
methods.description: Displays a page indicating the survey is closed, using Smarty template rendering.
